verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser runs a dedicated startups practice, wrote the book 'Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders,' and has an O-1 practice page, so founder visa guidance exists in its own materials. The pack does not show the rest of the menu or any guidance on choosing between options. missing for 10: documented coverage of H-1B including cap-exempt routes, E-2, TN, and green-card paths for founders; explicit decision guidance for picking the right visa; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's own materials cover the full startup visa menu — O-1, H-1B (including cap-exempt routes), E-2, TN, and the green-card paths — with guidance on choosing the right one for my situation

citations.quote: Our attorneys literally wrote the original book on the subject: Immigration for Startups: A Guide for Founders.
Foreign entrepreneurs and investors are often having to adapt visas intended for other purposes in order to use them for self-employment.
